state:
**Goal `ldap`, Stage 4 done but for a program-supplied CA; Stage 5 is the driver's earliest red check.** `nvs-config` reads `[ldap.<name>]` and `[capabilities.ldap]`. `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/ldap/mod.rs` opens connections (`connect`, `open`) and runs `who_am_i`, `search` and `read`.

**On `main`**: `Ldap\Connection::whoami`/`search`/`read`, `Ldap\Entries` (iterable, `references()`), `Ldap\Entry` (`dn`, `has`, `string`, `strings`, `bytes`, `toArray`), `Ldap\Filter` (`equals`, `present`), `Ldap\Scope`, and `Ldap\Settings` with `url`, `user`, `password`, `tls`, `timeout` and `base`. Each member has at least three `.nvst` cases under `tests/conformance/core/ldap-*.nvst`. Server cases reach `samba-ad` (`tests/db/compose.yaml`) at `ldaps://localhost:16636`, or over cleartext at `ldap://127.0.0.1:16389` for an `open` case. `open` pins one address, so an `open` case writes `127.0.0.1`, not `localhost`, which resolves to `::1` where the container does not listen.

`references()` returns `array<tainted string>`, not the ADR table's `array<string>`: a URL the server chose is server data. A finished search hands its references to the `Ldap\Entries` slot (`Step::Ended` in `mod.rs`), so nothing stays on a pooled connection.

`dn()` returns `string` until `Dn` exists (Stage 5).

items.text: **The rest of `Ldap\Filter`: `startsWith`, `endsWith`, `contains`, `atLeast`, `atMost`, `approx`, `all`, `any`, `not`, `toString`** (ADR 0278 § 6, `rule:core-classes/ldap-filter-is-a-value`). The wire enum is at `crates/nvs-ldap/src/proto.rs:51` and its encoder at `crates/nvs-ldap/src/proto.rs:150`. The class row is at `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/ldap/registry.rs:632`, and the bodies follow `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/ldap/search.rs:453`. The Rust tests `a_filter_encodes_to_ber_with_no_text_step` and `a_tainted_value_cannot_change_a_filters_structure` go in `crates/nvs-stdlib/tests/ldap.rs:357`'s file. The acceptance case is `tests/conformance/core/ldap-filter-builder-matches.nvst`.

**`Filter::parse`, which does not compile with a tainted string** (ADR 0278 § 6). The same rows at `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/ldap/registry.rs:632`. Acceptance case `tests/conformance/core/ldap-filter-parse-refuses-tainted.nvst`.

**`Ldap\Dn`: `parse`, `of`, `child`, `parent`, `rdn`, `isWithin`, `toString`, and `Entry::dn()` returning it** (ADR 0278 § 1). The `dn` row is at `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/ldap/registry.rs:478`. Rust test `dn_escapes_each_value_and_round_trips`, acceptance case `tests/conformance/core/ldap-dn-from-parts.nvst`.
**`Ad::memberOf` with `nested`** uses the in-chain rule (`1.2.840.113556.1.4.1941`). Rust test `ad_member_of_nested_uses_the_in_chain_rule` in `crates/nvs-stdlib/tests/ldap.rs:357`'s file.

backlog: `Ldap\Settings` has no program-supplied CA, so `open` cannot use LDAPS to reach a server whose certificate needs a private CA. It must be `tlsCa: string` (PEM text) under a `[capabilities.tls] anchors` host grant, per `rule:security/tls-trust-is-relaxed-only-under-a-host-grant`. A `tlsCaFile` path would be a second way to write that option. The dial is at `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/ldap/mod.rs:260`.
`Entries::total()` (ADR 0278 § 1) is not written. It needs a server that answers the VLV control, which is Stage 9.
